verses.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o le ositaulaga sili, “E moni ea, ua faapea na mea?”

verses.en: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia, “Soma e, le au uso e, ma tama e, ina faafofoga mai ia. Na faaali le Atua e ona le mamalu i lo tatou tama o Aperaamo, ina o i Mesopotamia o ia, a O lei oo i lona nofo i Karana,

verses.en: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.sm: ua na fetalai mai foi ia te ia, Ina tuua ia o lou nuu ma lou aiga, a e alu atu i le nuu ou te faasino atu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.sm: Ona tuua lea e ia o le nuu o Kaletaia, a e nofo i Karana; ua oti lona tama, ona ia aumaia lea o ia nai lea mea e nofo i le nuu nei, ua outou nonofo ai.

verses.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.sm: Ua na le avatu foi ia te ia se tofi i ai, e leai lava se mea e tusa ma se tulagávae; a ua folafola mai, na te avatua ia te ia e fai mona fanua, atoa ma lana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, a O leai sana fanau.

verses.en: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.sm: Na faapea foi ona fetalai mai o le Atua, e aumau lana fanau i le nuu ese; latou te faapologaina ma faasaunoa ia te i latou i tausaga e fa selau.

verses.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.sm: Na faapea mai foi le Atua, Ou te faasala i le nuu latou te nofo pologa ai; a mavae foi ia mea e o mai i latou, ma latou auauna mai ia te au i lenei nuu.

verses.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
verses.sm: Na ia tuuina atu foi ia te ia le feagaiga o le peritome; ona fanau ai lea o lona atalii o Isaako, ua ia peritomeina ai o ia i le aso valu; o le atalii foi o Isaako, o Iakopo; o atalii foi o Iakopo e toasefulu ma le toalua, o tupuga ia. j

verses.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.sm: “O le au tupuga foi, ina O matataua ia Iosefa, ua latou faatau atu ia te ia i Aikupito; a ua ia te ia le Atua,

verses.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.sm: ua na laveai foi ia te ia i ona puapuaga uma lava, ma foai mai ia te ia ia alofagia ma ta‘upotoina i luma o Farao le tupu o Aikupito; o lé na tofia o ia e pule i Aikupito, atoa ma lona aiga uma.

verses.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.sm: Ua oo le oge ma le puapuaga tele i le nuu o Aikupito uma lava atoa ma Kanana; ua le maua foi ni mea e ‘ai e O tatou tama.

verses.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.sm: A ua faalogo e lakopo ua i Aikupito saito, ona aau atu lea e ia o tatou tama, o le muai o atu lea.

verses.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.sm: O lo latou foi faalua ua faailoa ai Iosefa i ona uso, ua faaalia foi le aiga o losefa ia Farao.

verses.en: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.sm: Ona feau atu lea e losefa, ua aami i lona tamá o lakopo, atoa ma lona aiga uma lava, e toafitugafulu ma le toalima O tagata.

verses.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.sm: Ona alu ifo lea o Iakopo i Aikupito, ua oti ai o ia, atoa ma O tatou tamá;

verses.en: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
verses.sm: ua molia foi i latou i Sekema, ma ua tuuina i le tuugamau na faatau e Aperaamo i le tau ario nai le fanau a Emoro i Sekema.

verses.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.sm: “Ina ua latalata le tausaga o le folafolaga na tauto ai le Atua ia Aperaamo, ona tutupu lea o le nuu, ma ua faatoateleina i Aikupito,

verses.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.sm: ua 00 i le nofo mai o le tasi tupu, sa le iloa e ia Iosefa.

verses.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.sm: Ua na togafitileagaina o tatou aiga, ma faasaunoa atu i o tatou tama, ia tuulafoai a latou tama meamea, ina neʻi ola i latou.

verses.en: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
verses.sm: O ona po ia na fanau ai Mose, ua maeu le lalelei i luma o le Atua. E tolu masina foi ua tausia ai o ia i le aiga o lona tama;

verses.en: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.sm: ua tuulafoaiina foi o ia, ua avae e le afafine o Farao, ua na tausi foi ia te ia e fai mana tama.

verses.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.sm: Na aʻoaʻoina foi Mose i le poto uma lava o Aikupito; ua malosi i ana upu ma ana mea na faia.

verses.en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.sm: “Ua oo i le fagafulu o ona tausaga, ona manatu ai lea o ia e asiasi atu i ona uso O le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu foi e ia o le tasi ua agaleagaina, ua na fesoasoani i ai, ma taui atu i lona agaleagaina, ma fasi i le Aikupito.

verses.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
verses.sm: Fa te ia e iloa e ona uso e faaola le Atua ia te i latou i lona lima; a ua le iloa e i latou.

verses.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.sm: O le taeao foi ua tu atu ai o ia i le toalua o i latou o tau, ua na pupulu ai ia lelei, ua faapea atu, Soma e, o le uso oulua; se a le mea ua oulua feagaleagai a1?

verses.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.sm: A ole na agaleaga atu i le tasi, ua na tetee atu ia te ia, ua faapea mai, O ai ea na fai oe ma alii ma faamasino ia te i matou?

verses.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.sm: Pe e te fia fasioti ea ia te au, pei ona e fasioti i le Aikupito ananafi?

verses.en: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.sm: Ona sola lea o Mose i lea upu, ua aumau ai i le nuu o Mitiana, ua fanau ai ona atalii e toalua.

verses.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.sm: “Ua mavae foi tausaga e fagafulu, ona faaali lea ia te ia o le agelu a le Alii i le au muma i le laau talatala i le vao o le mauga o Sinai.

verses.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
verses.sm: Ua vaaia e Mose, ona ofo ai lea i le mea ua vaaia; ua faalatalata atu o ia e matamata i ai, ona tùlei mai lea o le siufofoga o le Alii ia te ia,

verses.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.sm: O au o le Atua o ou tamà, o le Atua 0 Aperaamo, o le Atua foi o Isaako, o le Atua foi o Iakopo. Ona gatete lea o Mose, ua le mafai ona faamalosi e matamata i ai.

verses.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o le Alii ia te ia, Tatala ta ou seevae; aua o le mea ua e tu ai o le eleele paia lea.

verses.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua ou matuā vaavaai î le agaleagaina o lo'u nuu o Aikupito, ua ou faalogo foi i lo latou feoi, ua ou alu ifo foi e laveai ia te i latou. O lenei, sau Ta, ou te auina atu oe i Aikupito.

verses.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.sm: “O Mose lena sa teena e il fetu o lo outou atua o Refana, o faalatou, sa faapea atu, O ai se na faia oe ma alii ma faamasino? na auina o ia e le Atun e fai ma alii ma faaola, i le lima o le agelu sa faaali ia te ia i le laau ralatala.

verses.en: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.sm: O ia lava na ta°ita‘iin1 atu ia te i latou, a ua uma ona fai vavega ma faailoga i le nuu o Aikupito, ma le sami Ulaula, atoa ma le vao i tausaga e fagafalu.

verses.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
verses.sm: O Mose lea, sa fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, E faatuna e le Ali lo outou Atua le perofeta mo outou o so outou uso, pei o aʻu nei; tou te faalogo ia te ia.

verses.en: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.sm: O ia sa i le faapotopotoga i le vao faatasi ma le agelu na fetalai mai ia te ia i le mauga o Sinai, sa faatasi foi ma O tatou tama; ua na “alia foi afioga o le ola e au mai ai ia te i tatou.

verses.en: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.sm: Ua le loto o tatou tama ina anaana ia te ia, a ua tetee atu ai, ma toe foi atu i o latou loto i Aikupito,

verses.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu ia Arona, Ina faia ia atua mo i tatou, latou te muamua atu ia i tatou; auā o lena Mose, sa ta'ita'iina i tatou nai le nuu o Aikupito, tatou te le Pon se mea ua oo Ta teia.

verses.en: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.sm: Na faia foi e i latou i ia ona po le tamai povi, ua latou fai foi le taulaga i le tupua, ua olioli foi i latou i galuega a o latou lava lima.

verses.en: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
verses.sm: Ona liliu ese lea o le Atua, ma tuu atu ia te i litou e auauna i “au o le lagi; pei ona. tusia i le tusi a le au perofeta, Le aiga o Isaraelu e, na outou au mai ea manu ua fasia ma taulaga ia te au i ona tausaga e fagafulu i le vao?

verses.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.sm: Na tauave lava e outou le malumalu o Moloka, ma le tusa na outou faia tou te ifo i ai; o le mea lea ou te avea ai outou e nonofo i tala atu o Papelonia.

verses.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
verses.sm: “Saio tatoutama ile vaole fale fetafai sa i ai le mau, pei ona poloai mai ai o ia le na fetalai mai ia Mose, ia faia e ia pei o le faatusa na vaaia e ia.

verses.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.sm: Na talia lea e o tatou tama atoa ma losua, ma latou aumaia i le laueleele o nuu ese, na tulia e le Atua i luma o tatou tama, ua 00 i ona po o Tavita.

verses.en: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.sm: O ia na alofaina e le Atua, ua na faatoga atu foi ia maua e ia se mea e afio ai le Atua o Iakopo.

verses.en: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.sm: A ua faia e Solomona le fale mona.

verses.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.sm: A e peitai o le Silisili ese, e le afio o ia i malumalu e faia e lima, pei ona fai mai le perofeta,

verses.en: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
verses.sm: O le lagi o loʻu nofodlii lea, o le lalolagi foi o le mea e tu ai o'u vae lea; o loo faapea mai le Alii, po o faapefea se fale tou te faia mo a“?

verses.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.sm: po o ifea se mea ou te nofo ai? so E le faia ea e o'u lima nei mea uma?

verses.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.sm: SI “O outou, e ua maaa ua, ma ua le peritomeina o loto ma taliga, ua outou tetee atu pea lava i le Agaga Paia; pei o outou tama ua faapea foi outou.

verses.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.sm: O ai so le au perofeta e lei saua i ai o outou tama? Ua fasiotia foi e i latou e na muai tala‘i i le auo mai o lē Amiotonu; O ia ua outou faalataina ma fasiotia nei;

verses.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
verses.sm: o outou, e ua maua le tulafono i sauniga a agelu, a ua le taofia.”

verses.en: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo i latou i ia upu, ona matuā lotoa lea o i latou; ua lilivau foi o latou nifo ia te ia.

verses.en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.sm: A ua tumu o la ile Agaga Paia, ua pulatoa i le lagi, ua iloa atu le pupula o le Atua, ma lesu o loo tu i le itu taumatau o le Atua;

verses.en: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.sm: ona fai atu lea, “Faauta, ua ou iloa le lagi ua avanoa, ma le Atalii o le tagata o loo tu i le itu taumatau o le Atua.”

verses.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.sm: Ona alalaga lea o i latou ma le leo tele, ua pupuni o latou taliga, ma feosofi mai ia te ia ma le loto gatasi.

verses.en: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.sm: Ua tulei atu foi ia te ia i tua o le aai, ona latou fetogi lea ia te ia i maa; ua tuu atu foi e molimau o latou ofu i le taulealea, o Saulo le igoa, e leoleo ai.

verses.en: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.sm: Ua fetogi foi i latou ia Setefano, o valaau o ia, ua faapea atu, “Le Alii e lesu, ia e talia mai lou nei agaga.”

verses.en: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.sm: Ua tootuli foi o ia, ma alaga atu ma le leo tele, “Le Alii e, aua e te tuuina atu lenei agasala ia te i latou.” Ua uma atu lea upu, ona moe ai lea o ia.
